title: Get information about your cannabis business owners

paragraphs: Info Page
The cannabis permit application asks for personal information and conviction history of all owners.
You will enter information about your business's owners when you apply for a permit. We will review every owner.
An owner can be:
a person or entity with an ownership interest of 20% or more of your business
the chief executive officer
members of the board of directors of a nonprofit
any person or entity that influences how your business will be run

sections.heading: Personal information
paragraphs: For every owner, you need to have:
Home address
Date and place of birth
Title in the cannabis business (like owner or CEO)
Percentage of ownership in the cannabis business
Name of current employer
If they have had a commercial cannabis license taken away in the last 3 years
Demographic data such as race, ethnicity, gender, income level, education (not mandatory)

sections.heading: Conviction history
paragraphs: In the application, you must tell us about serious, violent, drug trafficking, or fraud related convictions that any owners have. See the entire list of relevant convictions under Section 1615 (e) Discretionary Grounds for Denial .
When you get a background check through the FBI for the state application, you may discover out of state convictions.
If any owners have relevant convictions, we would like their:
Conviction date
Incarceration start and end dates
Probation start and end dates
Description of the offense, including the statute the conviction is under
These convictions could otherwise disqualify the business from getting a permit. But owners can prove that they are responsible enough to run a cannabis business.
You can upload a statement each owner has written for each conviction. Explain why you should get a cannabis business permit.
If available, you can upload a Certificate of Rehabilitation.
You can also upload reference letters from employers, instructors, or professional counselors. Date the letter and include your reference's contact information.

sections.heading: Business entities
paragraphs: If another company or business entity owns 20% or more of your cannabis business, we need:
Name of the business entity
Trade name (if any)
Address of the business entity
Date the business entity was incorporated (if applicable)
Percentage of your cannabis business that business entity owns
Formation documents (if applicable)
An explanation of the ownership structure, if it's complex

sections.heading: Equity Applicant businesses
paragraphs: If you are applying as a verified Equity Applicant, you can be:
Sole owner
Own 40% of the business and be the CEO
Own at least 51% of the business
A board member of a non-profit cannabis business where the majority of the board also qualify as equity applicants

You must upload a description of how you meet the ownership requirements of the Equity Program. You must also upload any other material agreements in place for the existing ownership structure and operation of the business. These documents include, but are not limited to:
Management Agreements
Memorandums of Understanding
Dividend Sharing Agreements, etc.

sections.heading: Equity Incubator businesses
paragraphs: If you are applying as an Equity Incubator, you must upload your Equity Incubator Agreement. This agreement must meet the Equity Incubator Agreement requirements .
You must upload any material agreements in place for the existing ownership structure and operation of your business. These documents include, but are not limited to:
Management Agreements
Memorandums of Understanding
Dividend Sharing Agreements, etc.
